gpu_note: Installed Torch build is 2.13.0+cpu and reports CUDA unavailable. GPU was never used.

host.note: Qwen3-8B is 15.26 GiB in bfloat16, which exceeds total RAM. No donor could be loaded conventionally.

streaming_forward.method: memory-mapped safetensors, one weight tensor materialised at a time, FP32 upcast per tensor, loop inverted so the weights are read exactly once per model
streaming_forward.disk_traffic_note: A per-prompt streaming forward would have re-read each checkpoint 59 times: 442 GiB for the 4B and 900 GiB for the 8B.

experiments.name: streaming forward validated against transformers on Qwen3-0.6B
experiments.result: PASS, worst relative error 2.81e-06 against a 1e-3 tolerance

hardware_policy_compliance.resumable: captures are skipped when a completed manifest exists; manifests are written after their data file

instrumentation_gaps: Process RSS is sampled after each model's pass rather than continuously, so it is a lower bound on the true peak. Free-memory sampling during the 8B all-token capture showed the host down to 0.5 GiB, which reflects memory-mapped page cache the operating system can evict, not anonymous allocation by the process.
Download wall time was not instrumented separately from the transfer.
